text:
Anita G.: Quick sync — we need a parity check for the VPC private deploy vs hosted for model `redwood-v1-small` before EOD. Can someone run a smoke bench and attach perf profiles? Looking for p50/p95/p99 and mem/alloc diffs. Tagging @Cheng Li @Tom H. :eyes:

Cheng Li: On it. Do we know which cuDNN/cuda combo the private image is using? Last hosted runs were on cudnn 8.4, private might still be on 8.3 which can explain kernel-level perf deltas.

Tom H.: I triggered a quick job: infra-bench/vpc-smoke-176512. Logs/artifacts uploaded to s3://rnw-perf/vpc-smoke/176512. Baseline (hosted) p99 ~420ms, VPC p99 ~478ms (~14%). p50 looks close but tail is worse.

Jules: Can you paste the exact command and image SHA so we can reproduce locally? Also which quantization flags were used?

Tom H.: run command: ```./perf_runner --model redwood-v1-small --mode streaming --seq 1024 --workers 4 --batch 1 --image sha256:abcd1234```
flags: `--quant q4_0 --kv-cache=yes`
artifacts: perf.json, flame.svg, sysstats.log in the S3 path.

infra-bot: Job infra-bench/vpc-smoke-176512 completed :white_check_mark:. Artifacts: perf.json, flame.svg, sysstats.log (s3://rnw-perf/vpc-smoke/176512).

Sasha: Hmm that p99 gap could be CPU scheduling noise or NIC/IO. Can someone paste `nvidia-smi -q` + `/proc/cpuinfo` from that host? Also are interrupts pinned?

Anita G.: Good call. Also compare kernel cmdline (nohz_full / isolcpus) and tunables (`/proc/sys/kernel/sched_*`). For quick repro try CPU isolation: `taskset -c 4-7 ./perf_runner ...` and set `GOMP_CPU_AFFINITY=4-7`.

Cheng Li: I'll re-run the bench with cpu pinning + perf record to get user/kernel stacks. Plan: 1) cpu pin; 2) toggle NIC offloads (rx/tx checksum, rps); 3) rebuild image with cudnn 8.4 and rerun. ETA ~90m.

Tom H.: Ack. If we still see the tail regression after cudnn parity, we'll collect `perf top` and a memory allocation trace. If it's network jitter we might see spikes in `sysstats.log`.

Jules: One more ask — include the exact model shard layout and RKV cache config. Private deploy sometimes had a smaller per-GPU cache limit which pushes more KV traffic.

Sasha: Adding a quick checklist: 1) confirm image SHA & cuDNN; 2) run with cpu pinning (taskset + GOMP var); 3) collect perf flame + `perf record -g`; 4) compare kernel cmdline + NIC offloads; 5) re-run with cudnn 8.4.

Anita G.: Perfect. Please drop the new perf.json and flame.svg here when done and @me. If rollback needed we can pin private image to hosted's sha `sha256:hosted-xyz` as a short-term mitigation. :rocket:

Tom H.: Started cpu-pinned run now, job infra-bench/vpc-smoke-176512-2. Will post results in ~25m.

Cheng Li: If anyone needs to reproduce locally, use the command above and the image `sha256:abcd1234`. Reminder: set `--workers 4 --batch 1` to match the production config.

Anita G.: Thanks all — appreciate the quick turnaround. If the run shows regressions persist, let's schedule a 30min sync. Otherwise we'll close this out async. :thumbsup:
